about: Leads for Pozzallo (Ragusa province), started from a reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23.

leads.name: The big trees of the Villa Comunale
leads.source: reader tip on r/sicily, 2026-10-23 (no name kept): 'a few of the biggest trees I've ever seen in Pozzallo the other day, in Villa Comunale gardens'
leads.note: No MASAF register row in Pozzallo. Needs species, which trunk, a pin and a photo; the tipster walked past days ago, so asking them for a photo is the cheapest route.
